name: Desku
description_en:
Desku is a hosted customer-support platform for shared conversations across chat, email and connected social channels. The inbox combines ticket ownership, priority, departments, internal notes and customer profiles; EVA AI and automation add generated replies, classification and workflow actions under plan-specific conditions.

A useful evaluation separates the free website-chat entry plan, paid shared-email support, rule automation and AI cost. Current official pages contain conflicting seat, trial and feature-availability wording, so this profile records the differences instead of combining them into an unconditional feature list. No tenant, channel, rule, AI answer, integration or subscription was tested.
description_zh:
Desku 是托管客户支持平台，集中聊天、邮件及已连接社交渠道的共享对话。收件箱组合工单归属、优先级、部门、内部备注及客户档案；EVA AI 与自动化按套餐条件增加生成回复、分类及流程动作。

评估应区分免费网站聊天入门方案、付费共享邮件支持、规则自动化和 AI 成本。当前官方页面在席位、试用和功能可用性上有冲突，因此本文记录差异，不将其合成无条件功能表。未测试租户、渠道、规则、AI 回答、集成或订阅。

en: Route new support tickets by channel and priority while preserving private team context.

steps.en: Build a ticket-created rule with a channel filter and explicit true/false outcomes; inspect private notes separately from public replies.
steps.zh: 用工单创建触发器、渠道筛选及明确真假分支建立规则，分别检查私有备注和公开回复。

steps.en: Verify actual nodes and AI key/token configuration in the selected account before publishing live responses.
steps.zh: 发布真实回复前，在所选账户核对实际节点及 AI key／token 配置。

pricing.billing_basis: Flat displayed dollar monthly plan with included seats, profiles and inbox limits; optional AI/token/visitor/seat add-ons. Actual currency and annual quote not established.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free $0:2 agents/200 profiles/one shared inbox; Growth $39:6 agents on card (FAQ says5)/5,000 profiles; Advance $79:12/50,000; Business $179:25/200,000. EVA token add-on $59/month up to5M, Copilot $29/seat/month with BYOK, extra Business seats $10. Annual discount and trial-card wording conflict.

faq.question_en: Is the API workflow action definitely available?
faq.question_zh: API 工作流动作确定可用吗？
faq.answer_en: The creation guide lists it as available, while the automation overview article marks it coming soon. Confirm the actual selected-account node before relying on it.
faq.answer_zh: 创建指南列为可用，自动化概览文章却标为后续；依赖前需确认所选账户实际节点。

faq.question_en: Does every trial require no credit card?
faq.question_zh: 所有试用都无需信用卡吗？
faq.answer_en: No-card headlines conflict with pricing/footer language requiring a card for paid trials and a refundable $1 verification. The free plan is explicitly no-card; confirm the selected paid signup conditions.
faq.answer_zh: 免卡标题与定价／页脚要求付费试用信用卡及可退$1验证的说明冲突。免费档明确免卡；付费注册需确认所选条件。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Separate a customer reply from the team’s private note
sections.title_zh: 区分客户回复与团队私有备注
sections.en:
The September 2026 dashboard guide describes a conversation list, the active thread and an About Customer panel. A header holds status, priority, department and assignee; saved views filter work such as unassigned or pending reply. The composer’s Reply mode sends to the customer, while Note stores private team context.

For a hypothetical return request, identify the correct customer and order before assigning the ticket, then add an internal investigation note and a separate public update. Inspect visibility with an agent role as well as an administrator. A merge suggestion is a candidate identity match, not proof that two customers are the same; exact merge recovery was not established.
sections.zh:
2026年9月面板指南描述对话列表、活跃线程及 About Customer 面板。顶部包含状态、优先级、部门及负责人，保存视图可筛选未分配、等待回复等工作。编辑器 Reply 发送给客户，Note 保存团队私有背景。

以假设退货请求为例，分配前先识别正确客户和订单，再分别添加内部调查备注及公开进展。应同时使用坐席及管理员角色检查可见性。合并建议是候选身份匹配，不能证明两位客户相同；准确合并恢复仍未确定。

sections.title_en: Build from the documented event and explicit false branch
sections.title_zh: 按文档事件及明确假分支建立流程
sections.en:
The detailed guides list ticket-created/updated, assignee/status change and tag-change triggers. Filters check ticket status, channel, priority, agent, team and tags, with true/false branches. Actions include ticket creation/update/deletion, notes, tags, followers, CCs and replies. These actions can change customer-visible work, so begin with synthetic tickets and a clear intended result.

The guides mark customer-created/message triggers, A/B, time and response filters, delays and agent notifications as forthcoming. One lists API calls as available and another marks them coming soon. A broad platform page is not enough to resolve that contradiction. Verify the actual account editor, selected plan and publishing schedule; do not build a critical delay or external transaction around an unresolved node.
sections.zh:
详细指南列出工单创建／更新、负责人／状态变更及标签变化触发器。筛选检查状态、渠道、优先级、坐席、团队及标签，并有真假分支。动作包含创建／更新／删除工单、备注、标签、关注者、抄送及回复，会改变客户可见工作，应先用合成工单和明确目标结果。

指南将客户创建／消息触发器、A/B、时间及响应筛选、延迟和坐席通知列为后续。一篇称 API 调用可用，另一篇称后续，泛化平台页不能解决矛盾。应核对实际账户编辑器、套餐及发布时间安排，避免依赖未明确节点实现关键延迟或外部交易。

sections.title_en: Inspect the result and retain human work when AI stops
sections.title_zh: 检查结果，并在 AI 停止时保留人工处理
sections.en:
Marketing describes AI intent/sentiment inputs and safeguards against loops or conflicting actions. No precise retry, rollback or conflict-order specification was established in the read guides. A useful pilot should include a rule whose action updates its own trigger field, a missing owner, a rejected external action and an incorrect AI classification; these are proposed checks, not observed faults.

The dashboard separates EVA involvement, autonomous resolution, routed-to-agent work and generated answers. Those measures describe different events and should not become a verified resolution rate without examining the underlying tickets. Pricing says exhausted Eva capacity stops Eva until reset or an add-on while other features continue; exact base-token allowances are not clear. Confirm the operational human queue rather than assuming a generated response completed the request.
sections.zh:
营销描述 AI 意图／情绪输入，以及防循环和冲突动作措施，但所读指南未确定准确重试、回滚或冲突顺序规范。试点可包含动作改动自身触发字段、负责人缺失、外部动作被拒及 AI 分类错误；这些是建议检查，不是已观察故障。

面板区分 EVA 参与、独立解决、转人工及生成答案，含义不同，不检查原工单就不能当成已验证解决率。定价称 Eva 容量耗尽后停至重置或购买附加项，其他功能继续，但基本 token 额度不清楚。应确认人工队列确实接手，不能假定生成回复即完成请求。

sections.title_en: Budget the plan, AI provider and eligible add-ons together
sections.title_zh: 一起预算套餐、AI 服务商及符合资格的附加项
sections.en:
Monthly cards show Free $0, Growth $39, Advance $79 and Business $179 with included seats and customer-profile limits. Growth’s card says six seats but its FAQ says five. Advance/Business add more channels and features; SLA, webhook access and collision handling appear on the Business card, while some connectors are marked coming soon. Plain extracted checkmark tables do not reliably establish every lower-tier inclusion.

Paid cards advertise unlimited Eva with BYOK. This is not evidence that external model usage is free. The page separately lists an Eva token add-on at $59/month up to 5M tokens, eligible Copilot at $29/seat/month with BYOK, and extra Business seats at $10. Its annual banner says two months free while the FAQ calls this 10%; do not normalize an annual quote from inconsistent wording. Billing currency, base AI allowance and complete add-on eligibility remain unverified.
sections.zh:
月付卡显示 Free $0、Growth $39、Advance $79、Business $179，并限制所含席位及客户档案。Growth 卡称6席位，FAQ却称5。Advance／Business 增加渠道及功能；SLA、webhook 及冲突处理列在 Business 卡，部分连接器标为后续。提取后的勾选表不能可靠确定每个低档权限。

付费卡宣传 BYOK 下无限 Eva，不能证明外部模型用量免费。页面另列 Eva token 附加项每月$59、最多5M，符合资格的 Copilot 每席位每月$29并配BYOK，以及 Business 额外席位$10。年度标题称免两个月，FAQ却称10%，不能由矛盾措辞归一化年付报价。计费币种、基本 AI 额度及完整附加项资格仍未核实。

sections.title_en: Resolve trial conditions and the unfinished legal identity
sections.title_zh: 明确试用条件及未填完整法律身份
sections.en:
The free card offers two agents and 200 profiles. Paid trials are described as fourteen days with a card and refundable $1 payment verification in the pricing FAQ/footer, despite no-card headlines elsewhere. Cancellation is described as ending future renewal without a refund, with access until the billing period ends and reduction to free-plan limits. These are published descriptions, not a completed purchase test.

The terms describe a cloud subscription, restricted access license and customer responsibility for reviewing AI output, but the named legal entity still contains a bracketed placeholder. Do not treat that text as a verified final counterparty or complete signed agreement. Confirm the service agreement, data exports, retention/recovery, selected hosting region and available UI languages. Desku merits evaluation for a team with a defined inbox/routing need; no claimed cost saving, rating, compliance outcome or setup speed was independently verified.
sections.zh:
免费卡提供2坐席及200档案。定价 FAQ／页脚描述付费试用14天、需信用卡及可退$1付款验证，与其他免卡标题不同。取消被描述为停止未来续订、无退款，当前计费期内仍可访问，之后降至免费限制。这是公开说明，不是完成购买测试。

条款描述云订阅、受限访问许可及客户复核 AI 输出责任，但法律实体名称仍带方括号占位，不能当作已确认最终合同方或完整签署协议。应确认服务合同、数据导出、保留／恢复、所选托管地区及可用界面语言。对有明确收件箱／路由需求的团队，Desku 可进一步评估；节省成本、评分、合规结果及配置速度均未独立验证。

research_gaps.en: No account, role, rule, channel, integration, AI or purchase tested. API node availability, Growth seat count, annual discount, paid-trial conditions, base AI quotas, currency, final legal entity/license, region, exports/restore and UI languages remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试账户、角色、规则、渠道、集成、AI 或购买。API 节点可用性、Growth 席位、年付折扣、付费试用条件、基本 AI 额度、币种、最终法律实体／许可、地区、导出／恢复及界面语言未核实。
